tooltip.binniegenetics.more_genes: %s more genes. Hold shift to display.
jade.binniegenetics.blocked: Paused: missing power, a required liquid/reagent, or output space
jade.binniegenetics.inputs_changed: Paused: inputs changed after the process started
jei.binniegenetics.acclimatiser.contract: Returns the same individual with an adjusted climate-tolerance stat; consumes one reagent only when that stat changes (1/100 tick attempt).
jei.binniegenetics.analyser.contract: Analyses an individual or completed sequence while preserving its genetic data components.
jei.binniegenetics.genepool.contract: Destroys the individual. DNA and ethanol amounts depend on organism type and life stage.
jei.binniegenetics.incubator.contract.ba: Every tick has a 1/20 operation check; successful output has a 20% reagent-loss roll.
Requires bacteria but consumes no input fluid; successful output has a 5% reagent-loss roll.
jei.binniegenetics.incubator.contract.be: After the 1/20 check this route has a 5% success roll and always consumes the larvae when a drone is produced.
jei.binniegenetics.incubator.contract.en: After the 1/20 check this route has a 20% success roll; successful output has a 50% sugar-loss roll.
jei.binniegenetics.incubator.contract.gr: Every tick has a 1/20 operation check; successful output has a 20% reagent-loss roll.
jei.binniegenetics.incubator.contract.po: Every tick has a 1/20 operation check; successful output has a 10% white-dye loss roll.
Requires polymerising bacteria but consumes no input fluid; successful output has a 5% reagent-loss roll.
jei.binniegenetics.incubator.contract.ve: Every tick has a 1/20 operation check; successful output has a 5% blaze-powder loss roll.
Requires vector bacteria but consumes no input fluid; successful output has a 5% reagent-loss roll.
jei.binniegenetics.inoculator.contract: Returns the same individual type with compatible serum genes changed and consumes one serum charge.
jei.binniegenetics.isolator.contract: Dynamic Forestry individual: randomly samples an active or inactive chromosome; 5% chance to consume the specimen.
jei.binniegenetics.polymeriser.contract: Adds one serum charge; costs 10 mB bacteria and 50 mB raw DNA per gene. Charged gold accelerates processing.
jei.binniegenetics.sequencer.contract: Consumes the completed sequence into the owner's genetic database and returns its empty sequencer.
jei.binniegenetics.splicer.contract: Returns the same individual type with compatible array genes changed; time scales with chromosomes actually changed.
screen.binniegenetics.analyst.instructio: Add a bee, tree, flower or butterfly to the top left slot. DNA Dye is required if it has not been analysed yet. This dye can also convert vanilla items to breedable individuals.
screen.binniegenetics.analyst.no_mutatio: No known mutations involve this species
screen.binniegenetics.analyst.requires_a: Analyse the specimen to reveal this page.
screen.binniegenetics.analyst.title: Analyst
screen.binniegenetics.database.click: Click to apply this gene to the carried serum
screen.binniegenetics.database.instructi: Carry an empty or spent serum, then click a sequenced gene.
tooltip.binniegenetics.lab_stand: Mount a genetic database; right-click to open, sneak-right-click to remove.
screen.binniegenetics.analyst.requires_d: Insert DNA Dye to analyze this specimen.
tooltip.binniegenetics.isolator.descript: The Isolator takes a random allele from a bee, tree or other individual and copies it into an empty sequence vial. This requires the use of ethanol as a solvent and an enzyme to cut up the DNA. The unsequenced serums can then be amplified in a Polymeriser and sequenced in a Sequencer.
tooltip.binniegenetics.sequencer.descrip: The Sequencer takes unsequenced serums and determines which allele is present in them. This process is slow and requires the use of fluorescent dye.
tooltip.binniegenetics.polymeriser.descr: The Polymeriser fills empty serums with Raw DNA and replicating bacteria. This process can be accelerated using gold nuggets.
tooltip.binniegenetics.inoculator.descri: The Inoculator uses serums to add genes to breedable individuals. This process is very slow and requires a Bacteria Vector, but is always successful.
tooltip.binniegenetics.genepool.descript: The Genepool uses enzymes and ethanol to break down living things into DNA. During this process, all genetic information is lost and the source of the DNA is destroyed.
tooltip.binniegenetics.laboratory_machin: The Lab Stand is a block on which an Apiarist Database, Arborist Database, Botanist Database or Gene Database can be placed by right clicking on the placed stand with the database, attaching it and allowing the database to be accessed by right clicking on the stand.
tooltip.binniegenetics.analyser.descript: The Analyzer takes breedable individuals and DNA sequencers and analyzes them to determine the genes present. This requires DNA Dye, created from purple dye and glowstone
tooltip.binniegenetics.incubator.descrip: The Incubator combines liquids and items and allows them to sit at an ideal temperature to encourage bacterial growth.
tooltip.binniegenetics.acclimatiser.desc: The Acclimatizer uses acclimatizing items to adjust the temperature and humidity tolerance of individuals.
tooltip.binniegenetics.splicer.descripti: The Splicer is an incredibly powerful machine that is used to insert genes into individuals. This process is fast, but requires monumental amounts of power.
info.binniegenetics.machine.isolator: Extracts one random allele into an empty sequence vial. Requires ethanol and an enzyme.
info.binniegenetics.machine.sequencer: Identifies the allele in an unsequenced serum. Requires fluorescent dye.
info.binniegenetics.machine.polymeriser: Fills empty serums with Raw DNA and bacteria. Gold nuggets accelerate it.
info.binniegenetics.machine.inoculator: Adds serum genes to breedable individuals. Requires Bacteria Vector and always succeeds.
info.binniegenetics.machine.genepool: Breaks down individuals into Raw DNA using enzyme and ethanol; destroys the source.
info.binniegenetics.machine.laboratory_m: Holds and opens a Genetics database.
info.binniegenetics.machine.analyser: Reveals genes in individuals and sequencers. Requires DNA Dye.
info.binniegenetics.machine.incubator: Grows bacteria by incubating items and liquids at the ideal temperature.
info.binniegenetics.machine.acclimatiser: Adjusts an individual's temperature and humidity tolerances using reagents.
info.binniegenetics.machine.splicer: Quickly inserts genes into individuals at a very high energy cost.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.isolator: Polymerise and sequence isolated serums before using them.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.sequencer: Unsequenced serums cannot be used for genetic work.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.polymeriser: Gold nuggets speed up serum replication.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.inoculator: Inoculation is slow, but never fails.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.genepool: Genepooling permanently destroys the source individual.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.laboratory_ma: Databases can be moved between compatible lab stands.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.analyser: DNA Dye is made from purple dye and glowstone.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.incubator: Leave room for the bacterial output before starting.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.acclimatiser: Acclimatising changes tolerance, not the current biome.
tip.binniegenetics.machine.splicer: Splicing is fast, but very power-hungry.
